name: @corespeed/lore-mcp
description: External Model Context Protocol adapter for Lore.

scripts.build: bun --no-env-file -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && bun --no-env-file --bun tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/bin.js
scripts.prepack: bun --no-env-file run --cwd ../.. sdk:check && bun --no-env-file run --cwd ../typescript-sdk build && bun --no-env-file run build
